finding.summary: get_commits_between() never checks data['total_commits'] against the returned commits list. The GitHub compare API caps the 'commits' array at 250 entries (and truncates large compare diffs), so for a PR with more than 250 commits since the last reviewed SHA the code silently proceeds with a partial commit list and a possibly truncated incremental diff, then posts a review that presents itself as covering everything since the baseline — exactly the false-coverage failure mode this PR's fail-loudly refactor is meant to eliminate.
finding.fix: After parsing the compare response, compare data.get('total_commits', 0) with len(data.get('commits', [])) (and treat an implausibly large diff body as truncated too); when truncated, return None so the caller falls back to a full review, consistent with the existing force-push/error fallback path.
